role: C04 small Material individual contextual source review
decision: Do not remove the owned exported legacy default factory in response to the peer checkbox factory removal. Material 16 aliased the peer token and factory; current legacy API and component still share the peer token, while the legacy factory and fallback are locally owned. The peer token factory changed, so identity, defaults, overrides and fallback behavior remain separate runtime obligations.

review_context.upstream_patch_summary: Removes MDC checkbox default factory export, uses shared checkboxDefaults token factory and component fallback; changes API guard.
review_context.installed_peer_source_observation: Peer checkbox uses checkboxDefaults and no deprecated factory export.
review_context.owned_reachability: The 16.2.14 legacy public API aliases both token and factory from @angular/material/checkbox, and the legacy component injects that shared token. Current legacy public API still aliases the peer MAT_CHECKBOX_DEFAULT_OPTIONS, and the component injects it; its exported factory is now owned locally and the owned base uses that factory for fallback. The local factory returns accent/check-indeterminate like the tagged factory. Installed peer token factory and defaults changed; neither token separation nor equivalence of injection/default behavior follows. Keep the upstream removal and shared-token behavior open pending mixed-peer identity, override, fallback and lifecycle tests.
